name: Haze
summary: Haze is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by two growers working under the name [[breeder:Haze Brothers]] near Santa Cruz, California, in the late 1960s and early 1970s. It is usually described as a four-way cross of [[mexican-sativa|Mexican]], [[colombian-gold|Colombian]], [[south-indian|South Indian]], and [[thai|Thai]] landraces, though some sources describe it as a three-way of Colombian lines alone. Seeds later reached the Netherlands and became the base of a wide family of hybrids.

sources.title: Haze (Unknown or Legendary)
sources.note: Planner-verified 2026-09-24: confirms the Haze Brothers (R. and J. Haze) attribution, Santa Cruz location, and era, but describes Haze as a three-way Colombian cross rather than the four-landrace account. Used here as the source for the disputed three-way version and for the breeder/location/era facts.

sources.title: The Strains That Shaped Cannabis Culture: Haze
sources.note: Planner-verified 2026-09-24: confirms the Haze Brothers crossed a Mexican landrace with a Colombian landrace, naming Acapulco Gold as the Mexican parent.
